speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Sit. The hall candle is lit. You are hungry, by the look of you, and you are early enough that I am not worried.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am hungry. I did not stay to help the yard empty itself. The bowl will do more for me than a conversation in a lane.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Broth, and the crabs from the dish by the fire. I did not send out for either. The penny loaf is done with for today.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Broth, then. I can see the crabs were already in the house. I will not ask you to invent a price for them.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: They sit on the firing, which you know, and which is not a riddle for supper. Eat. You have the look of a man who has been in a noise.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have been in a noise. I am not bringing it to this table. You asked for no title at noon. You will not get one now.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Gib is by the hearth, and not on a book, which is the first good choice he has made since morning. I am not fetching anything down.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Do not fetch it. I washed at your basin. The coat is on the peg. My hands are a lodger's hands again.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The stitch held, or you would have come in complaining of a shoulder. I am not a seamstress. If something is sitting on you, it can wait until you know the size of it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have no sorrow for the house. The jaw is still mended. The crust at noon was the report of that. This bowl is only supper.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Then take the soft of the crab. They toast down. I will not have the jaw proved again on a fruit, after it has already been proved on bread.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Soft, then. I am past proving. One candle when I go up. The hall can keep this one. I remember which flame is whose.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You remember because I said it at noon, and because I will say it until it is cheaper than repeating. I am not coming up to read over your shoulder.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Do not come up. If you see one light, it is a page. The page is not a story for the hall.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I saw the smear in the passage and I did not bring it to the table. That is as much discretion as a maid owes a paint-pot.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It was enough. The smear is off. I would rather the house had the crabs than a report of my ear.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The house has the crabs. Threepence was the dinner. This is not a second bill. Do not thank me as if I had sold it to you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not thank you as a customer. I will eat, and I will go up when the bowl is done, and I will not practice a part on the stair.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The latch stuck for me at dusk. It will stick for you. I am still not asking her to have it mended for a Wednesday.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nor I. A damp latch is not a workman's evening. Let it stick.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then we are a dull house, which is what I prefer on a playing day. Eat. Leave me this candle. Take your own when you go.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The broth is honest. I am not going to improve it by talking.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I will take the bowl when you are done. I will not take a message up with it. You can carry your own quiet.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I can carry it. If the light is out when you look, I finished. That is the whole message.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then finish when you are finished. The house will still be here in the dark. It does not need a speech to survive you.
